historical_run.model: Not reported: none of the image-to-3d, rigging or animation task responses includes a model field. ai_model was omitted on the model stage, which followed the API default; the rigging and animation endpoints have no model selection.
historical_run.note: Two live runs, one per language, on September 27, 2026, from fresh copies of the repository; the TypeScript run started while the Python run's animation task was in progress. Each consumed 30 credits (image-to-3d, a-pose, remeshed to 30,000, textured with PBR) + 5 credits (rigging, height_meters 1.8) + 9 credits (animations, action_ids [0, 466, 4]), read from consumed_credits. Model stage 124.7-125.6 s from start to finish, rigging 37.6-37.7 s, animation 27.4-30.6 s, no queue time; 204.9 s from the first task's creation to the last task's finish on the Python run and 208-211 s wall from start to files on disk. Neither run needed a resume.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; GLB JSON accessors and mesh/material/image/skin/animation arrays; joint names from skins[0].joints; clip names and durations from animations[] and their sampler inputs; Blender 5.2 headless import for the action list; FBX animation stack names read from the binary.
artifact_inspection.note: Python run artifacts (pictured). The TypeScript run produced a 7,073,508-byte GLB with 30,810 triangles, 32,386 vertices and the same 24-joint skeleton, and a 7,384,156-byte FBX. Both GLBs hold three animation clips named Idle (4.0 s), Regular_Jump (1.9 s) and Attack (2.8 s), in the order of action_ids, plus one embedded base color PNG; the clip names are the library key values. Blender imports the three clips as actions with Idle active; the FBX carries them as three animation stacks. Model files are not published by this repository.
